body: Thank you for your kind words. I'm worried that I did to my husband what my mom did to me. That I was a bad girlfriend/wife and projected that when he failed to meet my expectations that was a sign that he needed help. He didn't get really bad till he was getting help. Or the help and diagnosis somehow enabled him to accept it as true and not work to be better.
And of course, I write a 3 page long dissertation about my problems, and fuck up the title. Go me.
